## AX.25 Packet Node GB7CAM

GB7CAM is a 2m AX.25 packet radio node serving the Cambridge area.  The station procides node, mailbox and chat services using LINBPQ and is connected to the wider packet radio network via RF and IP links.

## Quick Info

- Band: 2m  
- Frequency: 144.950 MHz (TX/RX)  
- Mode: AX.25 Packet / Mailbox  
- Locator: JO02AD (Harston)
- Keeper: Ian Henry [(G0LFT)](https://g0lft.org)

```{=html}
<script>
async function fetchNodeSummary() {
  const statusEl = document.getElementById("api-status");

  const protocol = "https:";
  const subdomain = "api";
  const domain = "gb7cam.org.uk";

  try {
    let latestTimestamp = 0;

    // 1. Fetch Links Data
    const linksResponse = await fetch(`${protocol}//${subdomain}.${domain}/links`);
    if (!linksResponse.ok) throw new Error("Links API error");
    const linksData = await linksResponse.json();
    const activeLinksCount = linksData.links ? linksData.links.length : 0;

    // 2. Fetch MHeard Data
    const mheardResponse = await fetch(`${protocol}//${subdomain}.${domain}/mheard`);
    if (!mheardResponse.ok) throw new Error("MHeard API error");
    const mheardData = await mheardResponse.json();

    // 3. Filter stations and extract latest timestamp
    let recentStationsCount = 0;
    if (mheardData.mheard) {
      const fourHoursAgo = Date.now() - (4 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
      
      mheardData.mheard.forEach(station => {
        const lastHeardTime = Date.parse(station.lastHeard);
        
        if (!isNaN(lastHeardTime)) {
          if (lastHeardTime > latestTimestamp) {
            latestTimestamp = lastHeardTime;
          }
          if (lastHeardTime >= fourHoursAgo) {
            recentStationsCount++;
          }
        }
      });
    }

    // Format the time text
    let activityText = "No recent activity";
    if (latestTimestamp > 0) {
      const latestDate = new Date(latestTimestamp);
      activityText = `Last activity at ${latestDate.toISOString().substr(11, 5)} UTC`;
    }

    // Direct injection into your layout
    statusEl.innerHTML = `
      🟢 <strong>OPERATIONAL</strong> — 
      ${activeLinksCount} active links, 
      ${recentStationsCount} stations heard in the last 4 hours 
      (<small>${activityText}</small>)
    `;

  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Telemetry summary fetch failed:", error);
    statusEl.innerHTML = "⚠️ <strong>MAINTENANCE / OFFLINE</strong> (Unable to connect to home server)";
  }
}

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  fetchNodeSummary();
});
</script>
